entities.name: NADH dehydrogenase subunit 1
observations: The 318-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein O78696 from Lemur catta, with 100% identity and full-length coverage.
The protein is a highly hydrophobic multi-pass mitochondrial inner-membrane subunit of respiratory-chain Complex I.
Pfam NADHdh domain PF00146.27 spans residues 5–304 with i-Evalue 4.1e-107.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight 35,796.5 Da, theoretical pI 7.73, GRAVY 0.774, and calculated charge at pH 7 of +0.76.
Annotated role: core membrane subunit of Complex I, required for complex I catalytic activity and assembly; participates in electron transfer from NADH toward ubiquinone.

entities.name: Mitochondrial complex I
observations: NADH dehydrogenase subunit 1 is a core membrane component of mitochondrial respiratory-chain Complex I, which transfers electrons from NADH to ubiquinone and contributes to aerobic respiration.
